cleared.check: Producer evidence for FullMath.mulDiv with a product above 256 bits (MULMOD by 2^256-1 with a nonzero high half, MULMOD by the denominator, the twos and inverse steps at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:21-100) from mined Uniswap v3 style swaps. Every log with topic Swap(address,address,int256,int256,uint160,uint128,int24) in a window was paired with the previous swap of the same contract and tested against the single-step relations of computeSwapStep (exact input, exact output, target reached) as transcribed in tools/opdiff/v4math.py; only the relation that held was instrumented for mulDiv calls whose product needs more than 256 bits.
cleared.result: Monad blocks 125,000,000 to 125,059,999: 15,799 swaps in 173 contracts, 12,768 single-step matches, 2,816 of them through the 512 bit branch, every tick consistent with getTickAtSqrtPrice. MegaETH blocks 32,562,000 to 32,761,999: 6,670 swaps in 42 contracts, 5,644 single-step matches, 3,741 through the 512 bit branch, all ticks consistent. HyperEVM blocks 52,151,000 to 52,157,999: 9,057 swaps in 288 contracts, 5,700 single-step matches, 493 through the 512 bit branch. These amounts and prices were written by the block producers (MegaETH sequencer, HyperEVM validator, Monad block execution), and each equals the exact result of the source's formulas to the unit. Unmatched swaps are multi-step swaps or contracts with other fee rules; they are not evidence either way. Example transactions: Monad 0xf3c9f3e73087a78a5008d04cb8ce9d920146fa57de63cf27f1c76ef0cea9ace1, MegaETH 0x6f706deb6a1e64d80fef94769cfd847b2c0c2adda89e700428f037e5647a8d3a, HyperEVM 0x81b4a3afb08e7d65ef5c64dd6b777f9a3466ff790df4ae94a1a69a95b9f0c85b.

cleared.check: Planted faults in the reference used by the v3 style check, to show the check can fail.
cleared.result: A MULMOD by any modulus other than 2^256-1 that returns one more when the product exceeds 256 bits (the remainder step at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:48 and the rounding test at FullMath.sol:112) leaves 0 of the 2,816 (Monad), 3,741 (MegaETH) and 493 (HyperEVM) 512 bit matches standing. A MULMOD by 2^256-1 that returns one more when the high half is nonzero leaves 2,840 of the 3,741 MegaETH matches standing. That is a property of the algorithm, not a weakness of the check: for an odd denominator twos is 1, the flip at FullMath.sol:73 makes it 0 and prod1 * twos at FullMath.sol:75 is 0, so the high half only feeds the bound at FullMath.sol:30 and the branch at FullMath.sol:33. An interpreter fault that moves prod1 by one without making it zero or reaching the denominator would give the same pool results for odd denominators.

cleared.result: In 402,131 Swap logs of blocks 124,691,690 to 124,991,689 two swaps with nonzero amounts end on a tick boundary: 0x44eb49e850d3a4a3ab7671230d5e600b671128bf4b7935c291b5c17a445d2778 (block 124,893,705) and 0xbf1c7f77f95eb8e58b98f82dd9797313a06d7406059d723ea857c8ebf0ef88a7 (block 124,898,186). Both end on an initialized tick, and the PoolManager-only replay in the reference interpreter matches the block's call frames, the receipt logs, the prestate diff and eth_getStorageAt at the block. With the cycle 13 planted MULMOD fault both replays fail. These are the first producer instances of this branch on Monad.

cleared.check: The Q128 copy of mulDiv at pc 22358 (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:33 inside Position.update, src/libraries/Position.sol:93-96) and what its 512 bit branch can decide.
cleared.result: The constant denominator at pcs 22330-22377 is 2^128, so this copy computes feesOwed. prod1 is nonzero only when the fee growth delta times liquidity is at least 2^256, which makes feesOwed at least 2^128. Pool.modifyLiquidity casts feesOwed with toInt128 (src/libraries/Pool.sol:192), which reverts for any value of 2^127 or more (src/libraries/SafeCast.sol:56-57). On a node that follows the specification, this branch therefore always ends in a revert and its quotient never reaches state. Reaching it needs at least 2^128 units of fees credited to one position, which only a token whose author mints that much can supply (pool-creator). No mined instance exists on the three networks, and none is expected.

cleared.check: HyperEVM contracts that emit the v3 Swap topic with a tick one below getTickAtSqrtPrice of the emitted price (55 of 9,057 events, 53 from 0x586304481f7be6cb7738bbb913a693dfdd801480).
cleared.result: These contracts are 5,036 and 14,094 byte programs without factory() or tickSpacing(), so they are not Uniswap v3 pools and their event convention is their own. Their slot0 at the latest block gives a tick equal to getTickAtSqrtPrice of the stored price (for example -235,337 for price 614,990,369,859,390,990,714,731), so the node computes TickMath as the source does. No PoolManager event on HyperEVM breaks the tick relation (2,284 of 2,284).

leads.question: Which of the 51,032 MegaETH and roughly 2,800 HyperEVM PoolManager transactions call clear() with an exact credit? It emits no log, so finding it needs a callTracer pass over every PoolManager transaction, with pmreplay.py on the hits.
leads.why: clear is the one listed branch that a log scan cannot find. On the two networks with closed producers it still has only interpreter evidence.

leads.question: Can a Monad endpoint or indexer serve PoolManager logs over the whole history? rpc3.monad.xyz caps eth_getLogs at 1,000 blocks, and rpc.monad.xyz, rpc1.monad.xyz and rpc-mainnet.monadinfra.com cap it below that, which makes a scan of 125 million blocks take about 125,000 calls.
leads.why: Donate, approve, transferFrom through an allowance and operator burns were searched on Monad only in blocks 123,691,690 to 123,918,189 and 124,691,690 to 124,991,689.

leadResults.answer: Full-history log scans now show which branches can have producer evidence at all. MegaETH, blocks 7,009,653 to 32,761,736 (cycle 13 logs plus 32,746,001 to 32,762,000): 53,919 Swap, 187 Transfer, 47 mints, 140 burns by the owner, and 0 Donate, 0 Approval, 0 OperatorSet, 0 transferFrom or burn by a spender, 0 swaps with nonzero amounts ending on a tick boundary. HyperEVM, the whole life of the contract (45,998,366 to 52,157,974): 2,284 Swap, 1,669 mints, 354 burns by the owner, 2 OperatorSet (already replayed in cycle 13), and 0 Donate, 0 Approval, 0 transferFrom or burn by a spender, 0 swaps ending on a tick boundary. On these two networks the producers have never run donate, approve, transferFrom with an allowance or as operator, or operator burns, so no producer evidence can exist for them. Monad's windows (529,000 blocks) also hold none of these, and two swaps that end on an initialized tick now replay exactly. No mined PoolManager swap on the three networks has an amount of 2^160 or more or an amount times sqrtPrice of 2^256 or more, the condition for the overflow fallback at src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:43-52. clear of an exact credit emits no log and was not searched.

The MULMOD and mulDiv operand classes of the 512 bit branch have producer evidence on MegaETH from contracts other than the PoolManager: 3,741 mined v3 style swaps in blocks 32,562,000 to 32,761,999 need a product above 256 bits in the relation that holds, and each matches the exact formula to the unit. Monad gives 2,816 and HyperEVM 493. A planted remainder fault leaves none of them standing. For the PoolManager's own 512 bit copy at pc 22358, the branch always ends in a SafeCast revert on a correct node (src/libraries/Pool.sol:192), and no MegaETH transaction in the full history reaches it or the SqrtPriceMath fallback.
350 Initialize events over the PoolManager's whole history give keys for all 126 HyperEVM pools that swapped. Rerun with them, all 324 loop swaps match to the unit, none needing an inferred spacing.

Still unknown. web3_clientVersion on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm and rpc.hypurrscan.io returns only 'hyperliquid evm Mainnet'. The Hyperliquid HyperEVM documentation says the chain uses the Cancun hardfork without blobs and names no EVM implementation or version. The node README (raw.githubusercontent.com/hyperliquid-dex/node/main/README.md) documents flags and names no revm or ruint version. A web search found no public statement of these versions. The mined v3 style results on HyperEVM above show that the validator's MULMOD remainder is right on 493 shapes of the 512 bit branch.
